name: nader-execution-mode
description: Evidence-based execution governance for scoped agent work.

interface.shortDescription: Execute, verify, fix, and report evidence.
interface.longDescription: Turns substantial requests into a scoped acceptance contract, executes autonomously within authorization, verifies outcomes, fixes failures, and reports evidence without false completion claims.
defaultPrompt: Use NADER Execution Mode to execute this request, verify every acceptance criterion, fix in-scope failures, and report evidence.
